# Christmas Northwest

> Christmas light installation for homes in Seattle and the Eastside (Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Sammamish, Bothell, Kenmore, Woodinville and nearby). We hang commercial-grade Christmas lights, fix anything that goes out for free, and take everything down after the holidays. Installs start at $800. Owner-operated by Dylan Thornsberry, based in Kenmore, WA. Formerly known as Christmas Light Installers Northwest.

## Quick facts
- Business name: Christmas Northwest (christmasnw.com)
- Service: seasonal Christmas and holiday light installation, maintenance and takedown
- Phone (call or text): (425) 215-0935
- Email: christmaslightsnw@gmail.com
- Based in: Kenmore, WA 98028
- Google rating: 4.9 stars from 96 reviews
- Licensed and insured. First Christmas season: 2022
- Get a quote: fill out the form at https://christmasnw.com/contact. You don't need to be home.

## Pricing
- Installs start at $800 (clean roofline)
- Roofline plus accents: $1,000 to $2,000
- Full-property display: $2,500 to $3,500
- Large custom display: $4,000 and up
- Price covers the lights, install, free fixes all season, and takedown. Priced per job, not per foot.
- New customers pay a 50% deposit to hold an install date. The rest is due after install.

## What we light
Rooflines and peaks, garages, columns and railings, trees, bushes and shrubs, and wreaths. Every display starts with the roofline. Warm white is the most popular, but any color or mix costs the same. We use our own commercial-grade LED lights (C9 bulbs on rooflines, mini lights on trees and bushes) and plastic clips, so no nails or holes.

## Timing
- Most installs happen within a week of approving the quote.
- Takedown is included and starts right after the holidays.
- If a light goes out, text us and we fix it free, usually within a couple of days.

## Cities we serve
Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Sammamish, Bothell, Kenmore, Woodinville, Mercer Island, Issaquah, Edmonds, Snohomish, and nearby cities.
